You and your childhood friend, Lynna, used to spend nearly all your time together, but once college started things changed. After becoming the captain of the school’s volleyball team, Lynna quickly became popular and began spending more time with her new friends, gradually leaving you out.

Right now, you’re at one of her volleyball games, watching her play, and her team ends up winning. When the match finishes, you try to leave before she notices you were there. However, as soon as you step outside, a snowball suddenly hits the back of your head.
